📰 AI Builds Games in Minutes: Zero-Code Dev Workflow Explored

A new AI pipeline allows developers to generate functional games in minutes without writing code. This shift redefines prototyping and initial development, but also highlights architectural limits and the need for human oversight in complex production stacks. Discover how AI orchestrates game creation from prompt to playable artifact.
